_comment: Recorders to run on a standalone capture host. READ-ONLY market data only.
No credentials, no order placement, no trading. If a recorder here ever needs a key,
it does not belong on this host.
PAIRING IS THE POINT. The repo lost 35 days of Polymarket capture and the official
settlement window fell inside the hole, which blocked an entire research lane. Streams
that must be analysed together must be recorded together - so they live in one manifest
and one supervisor, not in separate ad-hoc launches.

recorders.name: pm_quotes_settlements
recorders.why: PM book + settlement. The pair whose 35-day gap blocked POLYMARKET_RESIDUAL_V1.

recorders.name: pm_l2
recorders.why: Polymarket ladder depth. Required for any executable-size or maker study.

recorders.name: binance_l2_sequenced
recorders.why: Sequenced depth updates. The single biggest unblocker - eight lanes need it.

recorders.name: btc_ticks
recorders.why: Trade prints at tick resolution. Pairs with L2 to infer whether a resting quote filled.

recorders.name: multi_venue
recorders.why: Second and third venue. Nothing about cross-venue leadership is testable without it.

recorders.name: funding_basis
recorders.why: Funding schedule and basis. Needed for carry, and the schedule must be READ, not assumed 8h.

recorders.name: deribit_options
recorders.why: Option chain. The only independent probability source available.
